description: Areas burned from February 3rd to 18th, 2024, around the Pico Basil Volcano on Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: FR20240222GNQ This map illustrates the burned areas as observed from Sentinel-2 images acquired on the 3rd and 18th of February 2024, over the Pico Basil Volcano on Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea. Coverage: Equatorial Guinea. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are disaster risk reduction-drr, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
